name: f1-calibration
question: Step 1: does the F1 calibration rule of the frozen specification (section 4) hold for the test-only reference evaluator, on 200 white and 200 correlated equal-depth synthetic planets?
choices: The rule as frozen at ab828ce: every result assessed and at most 4 OE_box > 3 per family; if it fails, the core is empty and the phase stops before step 2. A data unit, run once.
